————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries; Prime Minister: Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;

Total number of questions—20
Development of communication
system in the country
†*41. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount which was to be spent
on the development of communication
system in various States of the country
during the Ninth Five Year Plan period and
the details of the amount which has been
spent so far, State-wise and year-wise; and
(b) the steps proposed to be taken to
improve the communication system in the
country?
Procurement of foodgrains
*42. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it  is  a  fact  that
monopolization of procurement of food-
grains by Central and State agencies has
institutionalized inefficiency;
(b) if so, what measures Government
plan to take to reduce inefficiency in this
sector; and
(c) to what extent the consumers would
be benefited from these measures?
Controversy over location of
UCIL
*43. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Environmental clearance has
been obtained for the location of Uranium
Corporation  of  India  Ltd. in  Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) whether there is a controversy over
the location of the Uranium Corporation

of India Ltd. (UCIL) in Nalgonda, district
of Andhra Pradesh;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the reasons for people agitating on
dangers of the proposed Uranium project;
and
(e) by when the project would be
functional?
National policy for voluntary
organisations
†*44. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to formulate a national
policy for voluntary organisations so that
these organisations become self dependent
and improve their economic condition by
donation and other means;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when the policy in this regard is
likely to be announced?
BPL Scheme in Delhi
*45. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of families below
poverty line identified so far, State-wise;
(b) whether Delhi Government has
requested the Centre to lift the restrictions
on enrolment of people under BPL Scheme
in Delhi as it has large number of slum
clusters and unauthorised colonies
consisting of about 60 to 70 per cent of
people;
(c) whether Delhi Government has also
requested to enhance the annual limit from
Rs. 24,200 to 50,000 for getting benefit
under BPL Scheme; and
(d) if so, the decision taken in the
matter?
Reduction in H-1B Visas by
U.S.A.
*46. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that USA has
decided to reduce H-1B visas much less
than the proposed number of 65,000;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the US
Administration is seriously thinking of
reducing even the L-1 visas used to transfer
staff from one office to another;
(c)  if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the reasons behind this step and the
action that has been contemplated by
Government in this regard?
Expansion and Upgradation of I.T.
*47. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the steps to be taken
for the expansion and upgradation of the
Information Technology in all the States of
the country, equally;
(b) whether Government propose to
provide special assistance to bring forward
the under developed States in the said field;
and

15
(c) if so, the details of the proposals
accepted  for  the  years 2003-04  and 2004-
05 alongwith the locations thereof?
Talks between India and China on
border dispute
*48. SHRI N.R. DASARI:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether official talks between India
and China were held recently to solve the
boundary dispute between the two
countries; and
(b) if so, the details and the outcome
thereof?

Rural Industrialisation in Madhya
Pradesh
198. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of National
Programme on Rural Industrialization in
the Industrially Backward Areas of
Madhya Pradesh;
(b) the remarkable achievements made
in this regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rejection of loan applications by
Public Sector Banks
196. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
complaints from the States and beneficiaries
under PMRY about large scale rejection of
applications and delay in sanctioning and
disbursement of loans by the Public Sector
Banks;
(b) if so, the details of complaints
received during the last two years, year-
wise and State-wise;
(c) Banks which are major defaulters in
this regard; and
(d) remedial measures Government have
taken in this regard?
Promotion of KVI Sector in
Southern States

RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:

Cottage industries in Assam
199. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
prepare any scheme for the promotion of
the cottage industries in the rural areas of
Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of funds allocated by
Government for the promotion of cottage
industries during the years 2002-03 and
2003-04?
Nuclear power generating capacity
200. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a proposed to attain
4500 MW nuclear power generating
capacity with Pressurized Heavy Water
Reactors in the next four years and another
2320 MW would be added with Light Water
Reactors taking the total to 6800 MW; and
(b) what is the target plan of
Government during the Tenth Five Year
Plan period and how far it would help the
country to attain self-sufficiency in power
sector?
Setting up of Software Technology
Parks of India
†201. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had set up Software Technology Parks of
India in the year 1991 for promoting
Software export;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
STPI is setting up software parks at various
places with the cooperation of State
Governments;
(c) if so, name of the States where such
parks have been set up; and
(d) whether Government have any plan
to set up such parks in Himachal Pradesh
also, if so, the details thereof?
Post offices in Rajasthan
202. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the post offices running
in the State of Rajasthan, district-wise;
(b) how many of them are running in
rented premises; and
(c) the details of the post offices that
would be set up in the near future, district-
wise?
Communication facilities in North-
Eastern States
203. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of  COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether lack of communication
facilities has been a major drag on the
developmental aspects of North-Eastern
States;
(b) whether the present licensee for
North-East for cellular services are
indulging in restrictive trade practices by
not expanding the capacity of their network
and selectively seeking high-end customers
for existing cellular services in Guwahati
and Shillong; and

has any plans to provide cellular
connectivity to North-Eastern States and
if so, the details thereof?
Telephone connections in Madhya
Pradesh
204. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of persons on waiting list
for telephone connections in Madhya
Pradesh as on the 31st October, 2003;
(b) the steps taken to clear the
wait-listed applications; and
(c) by when, the list would be cleared?
